The tide table is honest about being wrong in one place, so I took it to the
hour it is wrong about.

At 03:00 the moon term is a straight line, and the table says the water is
where it was six hours ago. Standing at the real edge, the water was already
past my ankles.

I am not correcting the instrument. Its maker said where it breaks, and a
reading is not a repair. This is only the note of someone who went to look.
